Provenance.description: Explicit model/export attribution on every observation.

runtime.description: onnx-cpu, replay, or external-http; replay is always marked unqualified.

source_parity.description: Source-model/export parity, independent of successful graph loading.

WatermarkEcc.description: Error correction evidence, independent of calibrated confidence or authenticity.

corrected_bits.description: Corrected data/ECC bit count; unknown on failure. Schema bits are not BCH protected.

max_correctable_bits.description: This schema's maximum correctable data/ECC errors.

variant.description: BCH_SUPER, BCH_5, BCH_4 or BCH_3, selected by the two transmitted schema bits.

WatermarkFinding.description: Independent outcome for one compatible scheme.

confidence.description: Decoder score, not authenticity probability; unknown when unavailable.

ecc.description: TrustMark error correction outcome; absent for other schemes or unavailable models.

interpretation.description: Meaning and limitations of this particular decoder's evidence.

payload_bits.description: Exact verified payload bits, preserving non-byte-aligned TrustMark capacities.

payload_hex.description: Recovered payload bytes, hex encoded; absent when not verified/matched.

provenance.description: Exact model/runtime/export attribution when a model is involved.

schema_value.description: Verified TrustMark data schema (0..3); absent after ECC failure or unavailability.

scheme.description: Decoder scheme/variant/ECC identity, not inferred generator identity.

description: Combinable watermark evidence for wave 6 inspect-image (C2PA stays independent).

absence_limit.description: No detection is never evidence of human origin.

findings.description: Independent scheme findings, including unavailable primary decoder.

title: WatermarkReport
